description: A low, wide room glazed on the street side and open to the stair on the other. A chrome board names the four terrace levels. A bootscraper is set into the floor, unused. It smells faintly of wet soil from the planting upstairs.

window.description: Floor to ceiling along the street, so the hall is bright and entirely visible from outside. The view is Hughson Way and the towers on the far side of it.
window.name: the street glazing

name: 2 Hughson Way — The Entrance Hall
